provenance_note: Live headout.com collection, not a competitor-built proposal. Prices are the "from" figures rendered on the public pages listed below. The product-card API returned HTTP 403 from this environment, so nothing here came from api-ho.headout.com.
persona_assumption: Assumption, not measured Headout demand. Replace with booking-mix weights before a segment gap is used as a go-live gate. Axes are sampled independently; real travelers are correlated.

cost.note: MOCK run. Token counts are length estimates of template prompts. USD applies the published rate to those estimates so you can see what a live run of this size would cost. No API call was made.
